researchResults.description:

researchResults.title: AI automation startup Relay shuts down, staff joins Google’s Chrome team
researchResults.description: "We have some really ambitious plans to help you work with AI in Chrome to get things done, and I’ll have more to share soon," Jacob Bank, Relay founder and CEO, said.

researchResults.title: Nvidia investing $1.5B in SoftBank data center developer behind OpenAI project
researchResults.description: Nvidia's investment in SoftBank's data center developer will guarantee its chips power an OpenAI data center.

researchResults.title: Groq raises $350M to fuel its pivot from AI chips to neocloud
researchResults.description: Groq raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation as the former AI chipmaker pivots to a neocloud business and expands its Nvidia-powered data center footprint.

researchResults.title: Surgeons use da Vinci surgical robot to perform common cardiac surgery
researchResults.description:

researchResults.title: Amazon, which started off selling books, is destroying rare texts to train AI
researchResults.description: Rare books are incredibly valuable for training LLMs, since these models have already trained on whatever's available online.
